data.name: Sol Protocol
data.detailed_description:
GATHER YOUR TEAM

On board, you have to adapt to the dynamically changing conditions. Want to navigate through an asteroid field? Become a Pilot. Ever dreamt of shooting down foes with your turrets? Gunner is perfect. Or would you rather strategically plan your next move and manage ship’s shielding system? Welcome Captain. Each role has a distinct set of tasks to perform and handy tools to utilize throughout the journey.

PLAN YOUR BATTLES

Enemy spaceships are roaming the deep space, looking to destroy and loot your ship. Use different weapons and strategies to deal with intense randomized encounters and collect your loot afterward. Choose your battles wisely, warping away is sometimes the only way to avoid total annihilation.

GATHER YOUR RESOURCES

Resources are sparse, but vital both for the maintenance of your ship as well as future upgrades. Explore the deepest corners of the cosmos to find abandoned space stations and lost vessels to gather the necessary materials. Be careful, though - others are searching for loot too…

MAINTAIN YOUR SHIP

Keeping the ship aloft in space is a ceaseless but very rewarding task for the whole crew. Manually repair damaged components by replacing them with parts looted from abandoned bases and vessels. Carefully survey any damage and send nanobots outside to the affected parts. The ship itself is modular so each part can be individually upgraded to become even sturdier or to gain new and powerful traits altogether.

KEY FEATURES

  • Cooperative management and maintenance of the ship: each player has access to all ship's systems (rudder, weapons, shields, galactic holomap)

  • Deep space exploration

  • VR physical interactions: joystick to grab, tools to use, touch screens

  • Modular ship: completely accessible, every system can be damaged, fixed and upgraded

  • Real time strategic fights with procedurally generated enemies

  • Coop online 2-3 players with different roles to play

data.short_description: Sol Protocol is a dynamic VR Co-Op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations on foot, and make strategic decisions as you push deeper into the deep space.
